title: Open-Label Trial of Peripheral Blood Progenitor Cell (PBPC) Mobilization by Filgrastim in Normal Donors
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to clinically evaluate the spleen during PBPC mobilization by filgrastim in normal donors.
raw_criteria: Inclusion Criteria: - Eligible to be PBPC donor for allogeneic transplantation as determined by local institution Exclusion Criteria: - History of splenectomy - Previous PBPC mobilization attempts - Previous treatment with GCSF or GMCSF
